about: Visa Didi v1 test set (PRD: ~40 questions = 24 covered, 8 tricky, 8 should-refuse). Expected facts are regex groups (every group must match; any alternative within a group is fine), written from the official page text stored on 1-2 Oct 2026. 'sources' lists source ids or URL fragments; at least one must be cited. 'basis' says where the expectation comes from.
